title: Nourishing Syrian Lentils Stew
description: A comforting, creamy lentil stew infused with the rich flavors of stout beer and aromatic spices, perfect for a brunch that feels both hearty and light.
instructions: Rinse the lentils under cold running water until the water runs clear.
Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and add the cumin seeds, allowing them to sizzle for about 30 seconds.
Add the diced onion and minced garlic, sautéing until the onion becomes translucent, approximately 4 minutes.
Stir in the diced carrots and tomato paste, cooking for an additional 2 minutes until the mixture is fragrant.
Pour in the stout beer, scraping the bottom of the pot to deglaze, and let the liquid reduce slightly for 3 minutes.
Add the rinsed lentils and vegetable broth, bring the mixture to a gentle boil, then reduce the heat to low and cover.
Simmer the stew for 20 minutes, or until the lentils are tender and the carrots have softened.
Stir in the coconut milk and season with salt to taste, allowing the stew to heat through for another 5 minutes.
Remove the pot from the heat and stir to blend the coconut milk into a velvety consistency.
Serve the stew hot, optionally garnishing with a drizzle of olive oil or fresh herbs if desired.
